messages:
maria: Short thread 15we need a tight launch playbook for web copy + posts + benchmarks + webinar + inbound routing. Must map CTAs to Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Quick ideas?
jake: Ill draft the landing hero + 3 CTA cards and the post cadence. Want a separate benchmarks deep-dive or just highlights on the pages?
elsa: I'll export the infra run metrics and give three headline callouts (latency, throughput, security). I can also provide 1-line engineer quotes.
ryan: Webinar: 30m (20 demo / 10 Q&A). Panel: Product (maria), Eng (elsa), Ops (ryan), Customer (ask Glint). Demo: routing, fallback, Dedicated onboarding.
maria: Hero concept: "Predictable inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments." Under it, three cards: Hosted -> "Start free trial"; Dedicated -> "Reserve capacity"; Private -> "Request private deployment". Each card gets a 1-line clarifier.
olivia: Inbound form: add hidden fields: deployment_mode, interest_tier, region so SDRs can auto-route. Example hidden JSON: {"deployment_mode":"private","interest":"enterprise","region":"EU"}
jake: Proposed enums: deployment_mode=[hosted,dedicated,private]; interest=[eval,prod,enterprise]; region=[NA,EU,APAC]. We'll enforce on the form.
elsa: Public-facing benchmark blurbs (draft): "Hosted: ~85ms median token latency; Dedicated: reserved pools yielding 12k tokens/s steady throughput; Private: VPC + KMS/HSM for regulated workloads."
maria: Launch post sequence: 1) Teaser + webinar signups, 2) Benchmarks deep-dive, 3) Customer story, 4) Webinar reminder, 5) Launch recap/how-to-get-started. Each post points to mode-specific CTAs.
ryan: Panel Qs to prep: routing policy examples, handling bursts, fallback strategy, Dedicated onboarding steps, telemetry & SLAs. I'll draft 7 questions.
olivia: Routing mapping: deployment_mode==private -> team-enterprise@; dedicated -> dedicated-sales@; hosted -> trial-nurture-queue. I'll add these to the form builder.
maria: Deliverables: Jake = landing copy + 3 posts + webinar landing by Tue; Elsa = clean metrics + two eng quotes; Olivia = form fields + routing rules; Ryan = confirm customer and finalize Qs; Maria = hero/headlines + prompt snippets (2 per mode).
jake: I'll post first drafts to #copy-ops and link back here. :thumbsup: 
mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved Thu 10am PT. Calendar invite sent to panelists.
